# wool-model

A module to provide class to model Command and Event, the building blocks of Wool project Rule engine, CQRS / Event storage approach.

## Command

A class to model Command sent to Wool

### Parameters

*   `t` **[Date](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date)** a timestamp of the command emission
*   `o` **[number](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Number)** an order number for command issued at the same time
*   `name` **[string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String)** the name of the required command
*   `param` **[object](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Object)** the parameters key-value

### Examples

```javascript
const cmd = new Command(new Date(), 0, 'walk', {to: 'library', speed: 'normal'})
```

## EventStatus

An Enum of string, with following valid values :

*   `S`: the event is a `success`
*   `I`: the event is `invalid` (not validated by rule conditions)
*   `E`: the event is an `error` (an unexpected error happened during event treatment)

Type: [string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String)

### Examples

```javascript
if (t === EventStatus.succes) {
  ...
}
```

## Event

A class to model Event validated, executed and stored by Wool

### Parameters

*   `t` **[Date](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date)** a timestamp of the event storage
*   `o` **[number](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Number)** an order number for events issued at the same time
*   `name` **[string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String)** the name of the command that trigger the event
*   `data` **[object](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Object)** the data of the event (derived from command parameters)
*   `status` **[EventStatus](#eventstatus)** the status of the event
*   `message` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) | [Error](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Error))?** for status `invalid` or `error` a message detailing the reason of being unsuccessful

### isSuccess

Check if event is a [EventStatus.succes](EventStatus.succes)

Returns **[boolean](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Boolean)**&#x20;

### isInvalid

Check if event is [EventStatus.invalid](EventStatus.invalid)

Returns **[boolean](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Boolean)**&#x20;

### isError

Check if event is an [EventStatus.error](EventStatus.error)

Returns **[boolean](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Boolean)**&#x20;

### stringify

A method to make and [Event](#event) stringify itself

Returns **[string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String)** a stringified Event

### toString

A string representation of an [Event](#event)

Returns **[string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String)** a string representation of an Event

### successFromCommand

A static method to create [EventStatus.succes](EventStatus.succes) [Event](#event)

#### Parameters

*   `cmd` **[Command](#command)** the original command
*   `data` **[object](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Object)** the actual data after command execution

Returns **[Event](#event)** an event derivative from given [Command](#command)

### invalidFromCommand

A static method to create [EventStatus.invalid](EventStatus.invalid) [Event](#event)

#### Parameters

*   `cmd` **[Command](#command)** the original command
*   `message` **[string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String)** the explanation message for invalidity of the command

Returns **[Event](#event)** an event derivative from given [Command](#command)

### errorFromCommand

A static method to create [EventStatus.error](EventStatus.error) [Event](#event)

#### Parameters

*   `cmd` **[Command](#command)** the original command
*   `message` **[string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String)** the explanation message for error during the command execution

Returns **[Event](#event)** an event derivative from given [Command](#command)

### parse

A static method to create [Event](#event) from stringified Event

#### Parameters

*   `s` **[string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String)** a stringified Event

Returns **[Event](#event)** the event

### stringify

A static method to stringify [Event](#event)

#### Parameters

*   `e` **[Event](#event)** a genuine event

Returns **[string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String)** a stringified Event
